activity.notes: Dithmarschen lacked a single centralized executive command in 1500. Wulf Isebrand, an immigrant from Holland, became the celebrated organizer of the defensive fieldworks and a leader of the Dithmarscher force at the Battle of Hemmingstedt on 17 February 1500. ATLAS therefore records him as a military leader active in the peasant republic, not as its ruler.

sources.citation_text: The Schleswig-Holstein historical society identifies Wulf Isebrand as organizer of the defensive works and leader in the Battle of Hemmingstedt on 17 February 1500.
